subject: literacy
text_en: Children read text themselves, alone or with a partner
text_mr: मुले स्वतः मजकूर वाचतात, एकट्याने किंवा जोडीदारासोबत
text_hi: बच्चे स्वयं पाठ पढ़ते हैं, अकेले या साथी के साथ
look_for: Children's eyes are on the text and their own voices are reading, not repeating after the teacher.

subject: literacy
text_en: Children break words into sounds and blend sounds/aksharas into words
text_mr: मुले शब्दांचे ध्वनी वेगळे करतात आणि ध्वनी/अक्षरे जोडून शब्द बनवतात
text_hi: बच्चे शब्दों को ध्वनियों में तोड़ते हैं और ध्वनियों/अक्षरों को जोड़कर शब्द बनाते हैं
look_for: Sound work with meaning (clap syllables, first sound, make a word), not only reciting the varnamala in chorus.

subject: both
text_en: Most children, including back rows and slower learners, get a turn
text_mr: मागच्या रांगेतील व हळू शिकणाऱ्या मुलांसह बहुतेक मुलांना संधी मिळते
text_hi: पीछे बैठे और धीमे सीखने वाले बच्चों सहित अधिकांश बच्चों को मौका मिलता है
look_for: Turns are not limited to the same few front-row children; quieter children are invited and supported.

subject: numeracy
text_en: Children handle objects before pictures and written numbers
text_mr: मुले चित्रे व लिखित संख्यांआधी वस्तू हाताळतात
text_hi: बच्चे चित्र और लिखित संख्याओं से पहले वस्तुओं से काम करते हैं
look_for: Each child (or pair) counts, groups or shares real objects, then says it, then draws or writes it.

subject: both
text_en: Children who missed school get help to catch up
text_mr: शाळेत गैरहजर राहिलेल्या मुलांना मागे राहिलेले भरून काढण्यासाठी मदत मिळते
text_hi: जो बच्चे स्कूल नहीं आ पाए उन्हें छूटा हुआ पूरा करने में मदद मिलती है
look_for: Children who were absent sit with a partner or the teacher for a few minutes to catch up, instead of being left behind.
